amendment: RESEARCH_RULES_AMENDMENT_V1 (A1 LO20 gate, A2 rolling, A3 one model per layer, A4 excess-series cluster test)

books.predictive: overlapping MEAN_FORWARD_RETURN excess vs eligible EW

effective_start: layer live from 2014-03-12; sessions with < 50% of eligible names live are excluded from training and scoring (research period effectively 2014-03 -> 2021-08; declared before run)
feature_transform: cross-sectional rank in [0,1] per session over eligible live names

hypotheses.mechanism: Controller equity-pledge level, 20/60-session change, deal count, pledged cap vs liquidity and a price-stress interaction from weekly CSDC snapshots. Literature recorded BEFORE the run: high / rising pledge ratios predict crash risk and underperformance (2018 forced-liquidation wave); low or falling pledge = healthier controller. Long side = low-pledge names. One fitted model on this layer alone; LO20 gate; independence vs ML1 by excess series.
hypotheses.not: FEATURE_SEARCH; WINDOW_SEARCH; HYPERPARAMETER_SEARCH; REFIT_AFTER_RESEARCH; SELECTING_ON_VALIDATION; SWITCHING_BOOK; USING_AS_ML1_FILTER_AFTER_SEEING_RESULTS

independence_test: A4: corr of excess-vs-EW series vs ML1 (V25 SCORES_ML1_LGBM); > 0.90 = SAME_CLUSTER
label: cross-sectional rank of open(t+1)->open(t+1+20) return minus 0.5
level1_gate: fixed-split gates (pred net>0 both, excess/IC evidence>=2 both, FDR q=0.05, LO20 capital>0 both) AND excess>0 in >= 4 of 5 rolling blocks
no_search: features, lag, transform, label, params and schedule fixed here; one run
pledge_pit: snapshot visible first session after TRADE_DATE + 2 sessions; carried forward <= 30 sessions; absent name = zero pledge; snapshots after 2024-02-29 dropped
pledge_source: Eastmoney datacenter RPT_CSDC_LIST (中登 weekly 股权质押, TRADE_DATE = Friday); free; 2014-03 ->
universe: all eligible names in the frozen panel on live sessions

walk_forward.first_pred_rule: layer live start + 500 sessions (V25 rule of >= 2 years of labels; V25 global 2012-01-04 not applicable to a 2014 layer)
